_help: Hand-checked fixes for saved translations (cache/translations.json). 'set': Russian exactly as saved (numbers written as 701, 702 ...) -> English; applied at every start. 'prefix': the start of a long Russian text -> English. 'delete' and 'purgeOnce' ([Russian pattern, English pattern]) drop saved translations once so they are translated again. 'replace' ([English pattern, replacement]) and 'replaceWhere' ([Russian pattern, English pattern, replacement]) are applied to every saved and new translation. Your own fixes (overrides.json, Dictionary page) always win.
